session_summary: Blue title bar: 'HH DT, Then LH DT & Spike and Channel Bear Trend'. Higher high double top and Low 2 top at 07:15, higher low double top sellers set a lower high double top at 08:30, break below the wedge bull flag starts a spike and channel bear trend down to a measured move wedge micro double bottom at 11:15 low 4060 which rallied back to 4083.
